name: Create Jira Issue
description: Creates a new issue (Task, Story, Bug, Epic, etc.) in a Jira project. Use when the user asks to file, open, raise, or create an issue/ticket.
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.
Optional. Project key used when the user does not name a project.

summary.description: The one-line title of the issue. Required.

projectKey.description: Project key to create the issue in, e.g. 'ENG'. If omitted, the configured default project key is used.

issueType.description: Issue type name, e.g. 'Task', 'Story', 'Bug', 'Epic'. Defaults to 'Task'.

description.description: Full body/description of the issue in plain text. Optional.

examples.prompt: Open a bug in ENG: login page 500s on Safari
File a task to update the onboarding docs
